planets.name: TOI-836 b
planets.description: TOI-836 b crosses its star every 3.82 days and is 1.7 times as wide as Earth, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-836 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-836. Its orbit and size follow Hawthorn et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
